source_name: Banka Slovenije – Izdana dovoljenja Banke Slovenije (issued authorisations incl. management-board and supervisory-board fit-and-proper approvals)
why_relevant: Highest-authority primary record of leadership moves in Slovenian banks and savings banks: a filterable table of issued authorisations grouped into four categories, of which two are explicitly 'Dovoljenja za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave banke in hranilnice' and 'Dovoljenja za opravljanje funkcije člana nadzornega sveta banke in hranilnice' (ZBan-3 art. 309), plus qualified-holdings and banking-services authorisations. Table observed with ~147 entries carrying dates, person names and the institution concerned — i.e. a structured, name-level, dated log of board appointments approved by the supervisor.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register subjektov nadzora (register of supervised entities)
why_relevant: Entity-level pages for each supervised bank, savings bank, payment institution and e-money institution; the parent hub from which the authorisations register is navigated ('Banking Supervision → Register of supervised entities'). Gives the canonical actor list against which leadership-move events are joined, and entity pages carry status/authorisation changes.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja / plačilnih institucij (payments-sector registers)
why_relevant: Statutory registers (ZPlaSSIED) of e-money institutions, payment institutions, their agents and branches — the payments-side equivalent of the bank register. New entries / passporting entries are indirect but early signals of organisational change and hiring in the SI payments market, and the register is the authoritative list of payment-institution actors whose management bodies BS must approve.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Kadrovski razpisi (own staff vacancy postings)
why_relevant: The regulator's own recruitment channel, cited in BS job adverts as the canonical application URL ('Prijave ... preko aplikacije na spletni strani www.bsi.si/razpisi/kadrovski-razpisi'). Direct evidence of supervisory capacity build-up (e.g. analyst roles), of which supervisory/payments departments are expanding, and of internal reorganisation reflected in advertised unit names.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – legacy vacancy application (apl.bsi.si/zaposlitev.asp)
why_relevant: Legacy application endpoint that renders the live vacancy list; fetched successfully and returned 'Trenutno ni razpisanih mest' (currently no advertised posts). Very low-noise, machine-friendly page — ideal as the polled endpoint for BS hiring state, complementing the newer careers pages.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Kariera v Banki Slovenije (careers hub, incl. kadrovske štipendije)
why_relevant: Careers hub confirmed by fetch; sections 'Prosta delovna mesta', 'Zakaj zaposlitev v Banki Slovenije?', 'Nagrade prof. dr. Ivana Ribnikarja', 'Kadrovske štipendije'. The scholarship stream is an early pipeline signal (which specialisms BS is buying into) and the hub is the stable entry point to whichever vacancy URL is current.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Mediji / Objave (press releases and announcements)
why_relevant: Where BS announces its own leadership and governance changes in narrative form — e.g. the announcement that Deputy Governor Primož Dolenc took over the leadership of the Bank of Slovenia after the governor's term expired. Complements the register with reasoning, effective dates and portfolio splits among vice-governors.

source_name: Banka Slovenije – Katalog informacij javnega značaja (public-information catalogue: organigram, officials)
why_relevant: Statutory FOI catalogue that typically carries the organisational structure, list of internal organisational units and responsible officials — the cleanest baseline for detecting BS internal reorganisation over time, and the legal hook for an ZDIJZ information request if a needed list is not published.

source_name: ATVP – Prosta delovna mesta (Securities Market Agency vacancies)
why_relevant: ATVP's own vacancy page. Observed postings include 'Višji svetovalec področja I' in the funds sector and a sector deputy-secretary role in the IT sector — i.e. named organisational units, which double as an organigram signal for a small supervisor where each hire is material to capacity.

source_name: ATVP – Organizacijska struktura (organisational structure)
why_relevant: Names ATVP's sectors and their heads plus the Agency's director and Strokovni svet (expert council). Diffing this page is the cheapest reliable detector of both leadership moves inside ATVP and internal reorganisation, and it disambiguates unit names appearing in vacancy adverts.

source_name: ATVP – Register družb z dovoljenjem za opravljanje investicijskih storitev in poslov
why_relevant: ATVP's authorisation register for investment firms (BPD) and members of the investor-compensation scheme. ATVP is the fit-and-proper authority for BPD and DZU management-board members ('Zahteva za izdajo dovoljenja za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave BPD/DZU'), and an investment-services authorisation can only be granted alongside the board-member authorisations — so register changes are tightly coupled to board approvals.

source_name: AZN (Agencija za zavarovalni nadzor) – Prosta delovna mesta
why_relevant: Fetched and confirmed live with three dated vacancies (Aug 2026 postings, deadline 4 Sep 2026) in the IT sector, the Supervision sector and the Analyses & International Affairs sector, each with a PDF of full conditions. Very high-signal for supervisory-capacity shifts on the insurance side and, because unit names are stated, for AZN reorganisation.

source_name: AZN – Presoja sposobnosti in primernosti oseb (fit-and-proper assessment guidance) & Katalog informacij javnega značaja
why_relevant: AZN's fit-and-proper regime for insurance/reinsurance management and supervisory board members (ZZavar-1): questionnaires, criteria and process. Defines exactly which appointments require an AZN authorisation and therefore what should surface as a dated decision; the FOI catalogue is the route to the decisions/organigram where they are not directly listed.

source_name: GOV.SI – Zbirka Delovna mesta (central public-sector vacancy register)
why_relevant: Fetched and confirmed: a centralised, richly filterable register of public-sector vacancies (javni natečaji, interni natečaji, international postings) covering ministries, bodies within ministries and agencies — filters include institution (100+ entries), job type, status, location and date, with pagination via ?start=N and 20/50/100 per page. This is the single best structured feed for Ministrstvo za finance, UJP, FURS and agency posts, including senior/director competitions, and it carries an /en/ mirror.

source_name: GOV.SI – Direktor Agencije za zavarovalni nadzor (agency head public competition posting)
why_relevant: Worked example proving that the top-of-house appointments at Slovenian financial supervisors (AZN director) are advertised through the central government vacancy register, not only on the agency's own site. Establishes the collection pattern for detecting supervisor leadership turnover at the earliest point — the call for candidates, months before the appointment.

source_name: UJP (Uprava RS za javna plačila) – institutional page on GOV.SI
why_relevant: UJP is the public-payments administration within the Ministry of Finance — an operator of national payment flows and therefore in-scope as both employer and organisational actor. Its GOV.SI institutional page carries leadership (director), organisational units and area offices; UJP vacancies appear in the central gov.si vacancy register rather than on a standalone careers site.

source_name: Uradni list RS – Sklepi o imenovanju (appointment decisions) and the electronic Announcements section
why_relevant: The Official Gazette is the legally definitive record of the most senior appointments: e.g. 'Sklep o imenovanju guvernerja Banke Slovenije in člana Sveta Banke Slovenije' (2026-01-0281). Its Announcements section ('Razglasni del'), published electronically only, carries javni razpisi/javni natečaji and other notices that must be published by law. Authoritative, dated, citable and permanently archived.

source_name: Državni zbor RS + Urad predsednice republike – governor nomination and appointment channel
why_relevant: The BS Governor and Council members are appointed by the National Assembly on the proposal of the President of the Republic. The President's office publishes the nomination; the DZ publishes the vote. This is the earliest authoritative signal of central-bank leadership change — months ahead of the Uradni list decision — and the 2025-26 vacancy episode shows how long and contested the pipeline can be.

source_name: SPOT (spot.gov.si) – 'Dovoljenje za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave zavarovalnice' and related permit descriptions
why_relevant: The state business portal enumerates, per activity, every permit a financial-sector actor needs and which authority issues it. It is an excellent pointer for completing the actor/permit map (which body approves which board role — BS, ATVP or AZN) and for discovering permit types not visible from the regulators' own navigation.

source_name: AJPES – Poslovni register Slovenije (ePRS) and eObjave in court-register proceedings
why_relevant: Corroborating and often faster-than-supervisor record of who is a registered representative (zastopnik), board member or supervisory-body member of a Slovenian bank, payment institution or insurer, plus the eObjave stream of court-register entries. Person-level search is supported ('whether a given person is a founder, shareholder, representative or supervisory-body member'), which makes it the natural join key for validating a supervisor-approved appointment against the actual commercial-register entry.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – fit-and-proper framework and significance/supervised-entity lists covering Slovenian SIs
why_relevant: For Slovenia's significant institutions (e.g. NLB, and groups classified as among the three largest supervised groups in Slovenia), fit-and-proper decisions are legally ECB decisions, not Banka Slovenije ones. Missing this source would create a systematic blind spot precisely at the largest banks. ECB publishes the Guide to fit and proper assessments and the annual significance assessment / supervised-entity lists, and BS mirrors procedure descriptions at /en/banking-supervision/supervisory-practices-procedures-and-measures.

source_name: PISRS / zakonodaja.com – ZBan-2/ZBan-3, ZBS-1, ZZavar-1, ZPlaSSIED statutory basis for board authorisations
why_relevant: Defines exactly which appointments must be approved and published, and by whom — e.g. ZBan-2 art. 45 duties of board members, the sub-chapters on 'Uprava banke', ZBan-1 art. 65 'Dovoljenje za opravljanje funkcije člana uprave banke', ZBS-1 for the Bank of Slovenia's own governance. Without this the collection pipeline cannot tell a legally mandated disclosure from an optional one, nor anticipate where a new publication duty will appear.

source_name: Commercial job aggregators carrying regulator and public-finance postings (Optius, Careerjet SI, Borza dela, ESS)
why_relevant: Aggregators mirror regulator and ministry vacancies (an Optius employer page exists specifically for 'Ministrstvo za finance, Uprava RS za javna plačila (UJP)'; Borza dela and Careerjet carry 'banka slovenije' listings). Useful as a redundancy/latency check against the primary pages and as an archive when a primary posting is removed after its deadline. Lower authority: titles are sometimes rewritten and duplicates are common.

source_name: Slovenian business/general media as a leadership-move tripwire (Delo, RTV SLO, N1, 24ur, Lider, Svet24)
why_relevant: Reports supervisor leadership moves and candidate fields well before, and sometimes instead of, formal publication — e.g. coverage of the ten candidates for BS governor and of the prolonged 2025 vacancy after Governor Vasle's term expired on 8 January 2025. Also the only practical source for contested or withdrawn nominations, which never reach the gazette.

source_name: NLB Group – Sporočila za javnost (media centre)
why_relevant: Largest Slovenian bank; publishes named management-board and supervisory-board appointments, resignations and reorganisation announcements with effective dates, in Slovenian first.

source_name: NLB Group – Novice za vlagatelje (investor / regulated disclosures)
why_relevant: NLB is listed (LJSE + GDR London); board appointments are inside-information disclosures published here first, earlier and more precisely than PR items.

source_name: NLB – Objave prek SEOnet (issuer disclosure landing page)
why_relevant: NLB's own pointer to its statutory SEOnet filings, which include board-change notifications; useful as a stable anchor to the regulated stream.
